{'index': 0, 'text': 'iOS 27 為 Apple Wallet、日曆、備忘錄、地圖等多個應用程式帶來新功能。Apple Music 亦加入多項改進，包括以下五項新功能。', 'source': 'iOS 27 is bringing new features to many apps including Apple Wallet, Calendar, Notes, Maps, and more. Apple Music is also gaining a number of improvements, including the following five new features.'}

{'index': 1, 'text': '#1：橫向模式', 'source': '#1: Landscape Mode'}

{'index': 2, 'text': 'iOS 27 為多個系統應用程式新增橫向版面支援，Apple Music 亦包括在內。這項功能可能是為 iPhone Ultra 而設，但其他 iPhone 型號亦會受惠。', 'source': 'iOS 27 adds landscape layout support to many system apps, and Apple Music is one of them. This feature may be intended for the iPhone Ultra, but other iPhone models will benefit too.'}

{'index': 3, 'text': '有了橫向模式，你可以像直向模式一樣，邊睇唱片封面邊操作播放控制。', 'source': 'With landscape mode, you can view album art while operating playback controls, just like in portrait mode.'}

{'index': 4, 'text': '對我嚟講更重要嘅係，歌詞而家可以同封面並排顯示。我發現當 iPhone 放喺桌上或廚房充電座時，用呢個方式聽歌真係好享受。', 'source': 'More importantly to me, lyrics can now be displayed side by side with the cover. I find this a really enjoyable way to listen to music when my iPhone is sitting on a table or a kitchen charging stand.'}

{'index': 5, 'text': '#2：AutoMix 改良', 'source': '#2: AutoMix Improvements'}

{'index': 6, 'text': 'AutoMix 去年喺 iOS 26 首次登場，Apple 今年喺 iOS 27 及更新版本中對佢作出升級同擴展。', 'source': 'AutoMix debuted in iOS 26 last year, and this year Apple is upgrading and expanding it in iOS 27 and later.'}

{'index': 7, 'text': '同我嘅同事 Chance 一樣，我覺得 AutoMix 嘅轉場效果今年明顯改善咗。喺 iOS 26 嗰陣，我有時好鍾意呢個功能，有時又覺得好煩人。但截至目前嘅 iOS 27 測試版，我嘅體驗幾乎完全係正面嘅。', 'source': 'Like my colleague Chance, I find AutoMix’s transitions noticeably better this year. Back in iOS 26, I sometimes loved the feature and sometimes found it annoying. But with the iOS 27 betas so far, my experience has been almost entirely positive.'}

{'index': 8, 'text': '#3：藝人專頁全新設計', 'source': '#3: New Artist Page Design'}

{'index': 9, 'text': 'iOS 27 為藝人專頁換上全新面貌，設計靈感嚟自 iOS 26.4 對專輯同播放清單嘅更新。', 'source': 'iOS 27 gives artist pages a fresh new look, drawing design inspiration from the album and playlist updates introduced in iOS 26.4.'}

{'index': 10, 'text': '同專輯一樣，藝人專頁而家採用全螢幕色彩背景，襯托頁面頂部嘅圖片。上方有多個例子可以參考。', 'source': 'Like albums, artist pages now use a fullscreen color background that complements the artwork at the top. You can see several examples above.'}

{'index': 11, 'text': '藝人專頁亦將主要控制項變得更方便使用，重點推薦歌曲嘅標題顯示得比以前更加突出。', 'source': 'Artist pages also make their primary controls more accessible, and featured song titles are more prominently displayed than before.'}

{'index': 12, 'text': '#4：朋友播放清單', 'source': '#4: Friends Playlists'}

{'index': 13, 'text': 'Apple 每週更新嘅「為你推薦」播放清單系列喺 iOS 27 迎來全新嘅「朋友」播放清單。根據 Apple 嘅介紹：', 'source': 'Apple’s weekly updated “For You” playlist series gains a brand new “Friends” playlist in iOS 27. According to Apple:'}

{'index': 14, 'text': '呢個播放清單提供一個便捷嘅新方式，等你可以一窺朋友而家嘅心水歌單。每首歌曲都會顯示邊位朋友都喺度聽緊。', 'source': 'This playlist offers a convenient new way to peek into what your friends are listening to right now. Each song will show which friend is currently listening as well.'}

{'index': 15, 'text': '#5：特大尺寸小工具', 'source': '#5: Extra Large Widgets'}

{'index': 16, 'text': 'iOS 27 首次引入特大尺寸小工具，而 Apple Music 係最多應用呢個新尺寸嘅應用程式。', 'source': 'iOS 27 introduces extra large widgets for the first time, and Apple Music is the app that makes the most use of this new size.'}

{'index': 17, 'text': 'Apple Music 提供三款全新特大尺寸小工具：', 'source': 'Apple Music offers three new extra large widgets:'}

  • {'index': 18, 'text': '最近播放', 'source': 'Recently Played'}
  • {'index': 19, 'text': '推薦', 'source': 'Recommendations'}
  • {'index': 20, 'text': '熱播榜', 'source': 'Top Charts'}

{'index': 21, 'text': '你可以將呢啲小工具加入主畫面或者「今日」檢視，令個人化 iPhone 有更多彈性。', 'source': 'You can add these widgets to your Home Screen or the Today view for more flexibility in personalizing your iPhone.'}

{'index': 22, 'text': '你最期待 iOS 27 入面邊一項 Apple Music 新功能？歡迎喺留言區同我哋講。', 'source': 'Which Apple Music feature in iOS 27 are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.'}

{'index': 23, 'text': 'Apple Music 月費為 11.99 美元，你亦可以透過 Apple One 套裝訂閱。', 'source': 'Apple Music is $11.99 per month, and you can also subscribe via the Apple One bundle.'}
